svg.data-vd-steps: [[0, "Oxygen: need it, use it, or die from it?"], [1, "Nutrient agar tubes: oxygen diffuses in from the top."], [3, "Bacteria grow where the oxygen level suits them."]]
svg.title: Oxygen requirements of bacteria
svg.desc: Three tubes of nutrient agar with an oxygen gradient: obligate aerobes grow only at the top, facultative anaerobes throughout with most at the top, and obligate anaerobes only at the bottom.
svg.text: Oxygen requirements: the agar tube test

g.data-info: Need oxygen; die without it: grow only at the top of the agar (humans, most animals and plants, Mycobacterium tuberculosis).
Respire aerobically with oxygen but can survive without it by fermentation: grow throughout, most at the top (yeast, E. coli).
Oxygen is toxic to them: grow only at the bottom (Clostridium in deep wounds, methanogenic archaea).
